salary_details.details: The engagement is based on a self-earning/entrepreneur basis. Sources of income include service charges for provided services, input sales commission for recommended agricultural inputs, business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (C2C) marketing commissions, and a contingency fee for training sessions or programs.

selection_process: Graduation in Agri. & Allied Courses** 45 Points
The selection of KUs will be based entirely on a point-based system.
how_to_apply: Obtain the detailed information and application form from the office of CAO Budgam or download it from https://budgam.nic.in/.
Ensure you possess the requisite qualification for the post applied.
Fill out the application form with all required details including personal information, qualification details, and attach self-attested photocopies of mandatory documents.
Affix a latest passport-size photograph with white background on the application form.

Deposit a refundable security amount of Rs 10,000 (Rupees ten thousand only) in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt from any scheduled commercial bank in favor of the specified authority if selected (as per terms).
Submit completed application forms to the office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam in person or through registered post on or before 14-10-2026 (upto 4:30 PM).
important_instructions: The selected KU shall enter into an agreement with the APD and deposit a refundable security amount of Rs 10,000 through Fixed Deposit Receipt. Initially engaged for a period of 2 years, with the possibility of annual extensions subject to satisfactory performance. KUs are not entitled to claim any regular appointment under the scheme at any point of time. Assets provided by the department for KKGs shall remain the exclusive property of the department. In the event of a KU leaving the assignment or being disengaged before 2 years, the security amount of INR 10,000 will be forfeited. The agreement may be terminated by both parties with a 3-month prior notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Budgam District Krishi Udyami recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, District Budgam, to engage Krishi Udyamis (Agricultural Entrepreneurs) at Kisan Khidmat Ghars under HADP.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Krishi Udyami in Budgam?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available across pre-identified panchayat Level Kisan Khidmat Ghars in Frestwar and Yarikha Block Khansahib.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Budgam District Krishi Udyami 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of complete applications is 14-10-2026 up to 4:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Krishi Udyami?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields or Graduation in Science (BSc), or Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc/BVSc), with preference for post-graduation and computer diplomas.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 45 years of age as of the last date of submission.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Budgam District Krishi Udyami?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Krishi Udyami position?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit completed application forms along with required documents to the office of the Deputy Commissioner Budgam in person or through registered post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection is based entirely on a point-based system allocating marks for domicile, female candidates, and educational qualifications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of engagement for Krishi Udyami?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for a period of 2 years, with the possibility of annual extensions subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, KUs are not entitled to claim any regular appointment under the scheme at any point of time.
